turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Good morning, private banking, Rachel Tan speaking. How can I help?

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Hello, Rachel. This is Adrian Lim. I'm calling to arrange an investment. I'm back indoors after doing some gardening, so this is a convenient time to speak without interruptions.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Certainly, Adrian. Before we get into the discussion, may I have your identification number and date of birth?

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: My identification number is G zero seven three six eight nine six E. My date of birth is the thirteenth of June nineteen eighty-five.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Thank you. Have you been working on anything particular in the garden?

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Mostly repotting and clearing a rather untidy corner. It's a welcome change from the family business; I can put my phone away and concentrate on something quite different.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: That sounds like a pleasant break. We can keep our discussion focused. How would you prefer us to handle routine telephone updates?

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Keep them concise, please. A clear purpose at the beginning helps me make room between business calls. If something needs a longer discussion, I'd prefer to arrange a quiet slot rather than rush it.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: I'll note that communication preference. Turning to the investment discussion, Your investment objective is regular income and measured long-term growth through professionally managed bond exposure, with security selection delegated to a manager.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Let me get my notes in front of me. The fund I'd like is— The fund I want to transact in is Harbor SGD Bond Fund. For the quantity, I was considering 1,000 units.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: I recommend Harbor SGD Bond Fund because its pooled bond exposure supports your income objective, while professional portfolio management fits your preference to delegate issuer selection.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: I'd like to hear the remaining information before we finish.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: For Harbor SGD Bond Fund, rising market interest rates can reduce the value of the bonds it holds and depress its unit value. The transaction fee is 0.5%.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: I've closed my office door, so there's no need to hurry through the rest of the call.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Are you willing to accept investment losses in pursuing your income objective?

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Yes, I am willing to accept investment losses and valuation fluctuations in pursuit of income, but I prefer to avoid highly speculative investments.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Thank you. I'll keep the remaining administration focused and leave you time to refer to your notes.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: I want to buy, please. Please use Singapore dollars as the transaction currency. The monetary amount I am committing to this transaction is 500,000. Please use the quantity I mentioned earlier for this order. Please place this as a market order.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Your final instruction is to buy 1,000 units of Harbor SGD Bond Fund, with a transaction amount of 500,000 in Singapore dollars, using a market order. Do you confirm this instruction?

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Yes, I confirm that final transaction instruction. Please place the order as stated.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Thank you, Adrian. That concludes our discussion. I'll also retain your preference for concise telephone updates.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Thank you, Rachel. The focused call was helpful. I'll leave you to your day.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Thank you for calling. Goodbye.
